policy: static inspection plus existing negative-test receipts only; no write-capable script was executed to produce this matrix

cases.wrong_step_example: skip a required predecessor or enter the wrong original phase (e.g. build cache before P4/P5, or run research before L1-L4 seal)
cases.expected_policy_action: NO_PHASE_SKIP; research Layer 5 forbidden until Layers 1-4 PASS; phase advance only via the next phase's pass predicate
cases.current_implementation_action: no runtime phase guard was found; phase state is data in CURRENT files and is not checked before task execution
cases.explicit_gap_for_gpt: OEL-01: implement a phase guard that reads active_phase and blocks research/update entry when the predecessor is not PASS

cases.wrong_step_example: hash/Manifest mismatch, or an invalid runtime interpreter, treated as 'close enough'
cases.expected_policy_action: FAIL_CLOSED: MUST_READ_PRECHECK=FAIL, TASK_EXECUTION_FORBIDDEN=TRUE; no HAND_READ=YES override
cases.current_implementation_action: implemented in the preflight self-probe (tampered file -> G2_SHA_FAIL_CLOSED)
cases.linked_experience_card: error_repair_lessons L-ACTIVE-SEED-...-11 (no false PASS) and -12 (no REVIEW_REQUIRED rewrite)

cases.wrong_step_example: an unregistered or ambiguous source/schema alias is 'resolved' by guessing, or a legacy reader silently returns zero rows
cases.expected_policy_action: explicit alias table only; ambiguous finance datasets require --scope; a schema mismatch is a reader error, not an empty dataset
cases.current_implementation_action: resolver enforces explicit aliases and scope; measured in R08: the legacy price reader returned 0 rows on the canonical index schema while the successor adapter preserved every row and field
cases.explicit_gap_for_gpt: OEL-09: register reader/schema compatibility per product instead of relying on a per-task adapter

cases.wrong_step_example: wrong date axis / ordinal, stale calendar, date or frequency substitution
cases.expected_policy_action: frequency and date axis are admission predicates (frequency_gate); adjust factors must use the correct ordinal/known-at axis; substitution is a block, not a fallback
cases.current_implementation_action: engine rule declares frequency_gate BLOCK_FREQUENCY_GATE; no code emits it; adjust-factor ordinal handling is counted in R08 evidence (17 ordinal vs 20 timestamp incrementals) but no gate reads it
cases.explicit_gap_for_gpt: OEL-07 (no gate emission) and OEL-10 (no ordinal-axis admission check)

cases.wrong_step_example: the selected file/subset looks empty while another registered layer or shard serves the data
cases.expected_policy_action: read all registered overlapping shards and all registered layers before any absence statement
cases.current_implementation_action: resolver resolves one product path; the STOCK_MINUTE_1M branch is the only one returning multiple source_paths; no generic enumerator
cases.explicit_gap_for_gpt: OEL-04: generic registered-layer/shard enumeration for completeness statements

cases.wrong_step_example: cap/pagination incomplete (e.g. returned_rows == 5000) recorded as COMPLETE
cases.expected_policy_action: UNKNOWN_INCOMPLETE_ACQUISITION; page further; SILENT_TRUNCATION=0 before PASS
cases.current_implementation_action: implemented: absence gate treats cap hit as UNKNOWN_INCOMPLETE_ACQUISITION; acquisition rule sets SILENT_TRUNCATION=0

cases.wrong_step_example: EOD data used before its known_at, missing PIT, or an unsupported adjustment mode
cases.expected_policy_action: PIT gate + adjustment gate BLOCK; non-RAW_NONE adjustment blocked in the current architecture phase
cases.current_implementation_action: PreIngestionGate emits PIT_NOT_PROVEN / PRICE_BASIS_NOT_AVAILABLE and blocks non-RAW_NONE adjustment; the 15 canonical BLOCK_*_GATE codes are absent

cases.wrong_step_example: parent history lost, a dependent product not recomputed, or cache coverage regressing versus the parent
cases.expected_policy_action: PUBLISH_ALLOWED=false on lost dates; CURRENT_SWITCH_ALLOWED=false on critical regression; untouched products must exactly inherit the parent
cases.current_implementation_action: the non-regression gate module is a 2-byte stub with no gate/self_test, so the lost-date check cannot run; only FORMAL_COVERAGE_MAX>=target is checked at publish
cases.linked_experience_card: CACHE_REGRESSION forensics in coverage control plane build; error_repair_lessons L-ACTIVE-SEED-...-09
cases.explicit_gap_for_gpt: OEL-02: implement gate(parent, candidate, products) and wire it into publish_atomic before any CURRENT switch

cases.wrong_step_example: Cleaning/Cache/CURRENT disagree, or a candidate release is treated as published
cases.expected_policy_action: BUILD != PUBLISH; publish only through the authorized atomic gate, with backup of the previous pointer; embedded release ids must not override live CURRENT
cases.current_implementation_action: publish_atomic enforces generation equality and a full production matrix, but the daily orchestrator never calls it; rule bodies also embed stale R22 release ids while live CURRENT is FUND_NAV 2026-09-24
cases.explicit_gap_for_gpt: OEL-03 + OEL-11 (stale embedded CURRENT inside rule bodies)

cases.wrong_step_example: a failed MASTER prerequisite is passed into engine ingestion
cases.expected_policy_action: MASTER resolution must fail before pre-ingestion validation; parse must be impossible without a gate PASS
cases.current_implementation_action: implemented: task_entry runs master.resolve first and returns MASTER_RESOLUTION on failure; parse_after_gate raises PARSE_WITHOUT_PRE_INGESTION

cases.wrong_step_example: an ETF-only result advertised as a complete FUND-like union
cases.expected_policy_action: forbid ETF-only scan for fund-like assets; commodity/fund long history must go through FUND + FUND_LIKE_ASSET_VIEW
cases.current_implementation_action: declared in the cache-first rule only; no code implements the block
cases.explicit_gap_for_gpt: OEL-12: implement the fund-like union check (no CODE, currently text-only)

cases.wrong_step_example: retry/re-download when local RAW is already present, or when a sealed paid-permission exclusion applies
cases.expected_policy_action: RAW_REDOWNLOAD_DEFAULT=FORBIDDEN_IF_RAW_COMPLETE; first no_permission writes an exclusion and is never retried
cases.current_implementation_action: declared in rules/lessons; no runtime reader of the exclusion list was found in the acquisition path (pagination engine's live canary is a stub)
cases.explicit_gap_for_gpt: OEL-13: wire exclusion/checkpoint into the acquisition entry

cases.wrong_step_example: a lane-level success announced as 'daily update complete' (JQ-only claim)
cases.expected_policy_action: six lanes have distinct meanings; completion requires ALL_LANES_READY=YES plus per-lane status
cases.current_implementation_action: manifest carries six lanes, but no gate prevents a JQ-only statement
cases.explicit_gap_for_gpt: OEL-14: completion gate on manifest lanes

cases.wrong_step_example: a directory that exists is treated as an authority (folder=truth)
cases.expected_policy_action: authority comes from a body (rule/CURRENT/manifest), never from a directory name; archive and strategy outputs are not data authority
cases.current_implementation_action: resolver reads CURRENT pointers and explicit aliases from disk instead of guessing paths
cases.explicit_gap_for_gpt: OEL-15: mojibake/orphan roots (杩愯, 浠诲姟) have no mapping row; classify, do not silently delete
